hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md ]; then echo '## Recent locked decisions (plan file)'; echo ''; grep -E '^\| (W?[0-9]+|RP[0-9]+|F[0-9]+|S[0-9]+|P[0-9]+|A[0-9]+) \|' .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md | tail -3 | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $2); gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $3); printf "- **%s** -- %s\n", $2, $3}'; echo ''; echo '_Full plan: .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md_'; fi
